event.name: 2026 Esri European Partner Conference and Developer & Technology Summit

sessions.title: Native Mobile App Development with Flutter at Norwegian Air Ambulance
sessions.description: Learn more about Norwegian Air Ambulance, the background behind the HemsWX mobile app, and our development journey with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Flutter, highlighting both the challenges faced and the successes achieved.

sessions.title: AI-Powered Tree Detection for Climate-Resilient Urban Planning in Berlin
sessions.description: Urban trees are critical infrastructure in the fight against climate change, yet municipal tree registers are often incomplete and therefore insufficient as a basis for data-driven planning. We present an AI-powered workflow that automatically detects and classifies trees from aerial imagery using deep learning in ArcGIS Pro. Applied to the Adlershof technology campus in Berlin, Germany's largest technology cluster, the model identified more than 15,400 previously unregistered trees. The results feed directly into a GIS-based Digital Twin of the campus, enabling climate resilience analyses.

sessions.title: Digital Incident File for Firefighters: Integration of GIS into a Standard DMS
sessions.description: In the City of Baden-Baden firefighters work with a digital incident file. As soon as the Emergency Control Center raises an alarm for the firefighters, a digital process is started to create an incident file in the city administration's document management system (DMS). By means of a Python script information is harvested and sent to a Geoevent Server which then triggers a process to create an incident file in the DMS. After the mission, firefighters can complete the file in their office. With an embedded map created with ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript office staff can review the location.

sessions.title: The Machinery Behind a Map: Daily BigQuery-to-ArcGIS Sync with Airflow
sessions.description: Allegro's expansion team relies on daily, map-ready data to decide where to place parcel lockers. We show how we orchestrate updates from Google BigQuery into ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise using Apache Airflow and purpose-built operators. Instead of full reloads, a differential sync computes adds, updates and deletes, syncing ~200k points and polygons daily through the ArcGIS REST API. A dozen automated workflows—APM locations, Salesforce leads and more—feed our Site Selection app, used by nearly 100 analysts every day.

sessions.title: European Developer & Technology Summit Plenary: Part 1
sessions.description: The plenary session kicks off by welcoming attendees to the event, followed by an overall vision for ArcGIS today and plans for the future described by Euan Cameron, Esri's CTO for Developer Technologies. Then, Jeroen van Winden, CTO of Esri Nederland presents a talk about data sovereignty, which is a critically important issue and evolving concern for Europe.

sessions.title: Closing Session
sessions.description: Wrap up your summit experience by reflecting on the insights, best practices, and lessons you can take back and apply to your work.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Using Agentic AI to Easily Create Geospatial Test Data for Your Infrastructure
sessions.description: Agentic AI may be used to interact with ArcGIS Enterprise in different ways, e.g. for the generation of test data for different scenarios and environments. If the content of the data doesn't matter that much and a feature is considered just a geometry with attributes, it's very easy to generate a CSV with 10k points for a hosted feature service, build an OpenSearch-DB to get a view layer in ArcGIS Pro based on just a GeoJSON or import data into your EGDB with a vibe-coded Python script. In this talk, examples will be given to show you, how easy it is, to populate your testing infrastructure with e.g. Claude Code.

sessions.title: Talk to Your Map: Early Lessons with the ArcGIS Enterprise MCP Server (Beta)
sessions.description: The ArcGIS Enterprise MCP-Server (Beta) lets an AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) talk directly to ArcGIS. We spent time hands-on with the beta to see what it can and can't do yet, and we want to share what we learned. We'll walk through our experience from end to end: connecting an AI assistant to ArcGIS Enterprise, what worked well, what didn't, and where the rough edges are. And we'll talk about what it would take to make this genuinely useful in practice.

sessions.title: ArcGIS: An Overview of 3D Capabilities
sessions.description: With 3D capabilities, you can uncover deeper spatial insights and transform how data is managed, analyzed, visualized, and interpreted in ArcGIS. This session highlights how 3D GIS empowers smarter decisions across industries, while sharing practical knowledge on Esri’s 3D road map, strategy, and future direction. Join us to explore real-world applications, discover best practices, and gain insight into how 3D technology can enhance workflows, unlock new possibilities, and connect data to the real world in more meaningful ways.

sessions.title: 3D GIS: Working with the 3D Object Layer
sessions.description: Join us for a practical session on the "3D Object Scene Layer," a new ArcGIS layer type that enhances its capabilities as a 3D system of record. This layer type efficiently stores 3D models of various file types, enabling cross-platform integration and data management. We will explore how to publish this layer type using ArcGIS Pro, interact with it on the web through Scene Viewer, and build custom workflows with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. With the help of realistic use cases we will showcase the layer's effectiveness in various applications.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Reality: Launching a City-Wide 3D Digital Twin for Asset Management
sessions.description: Learn how to create and update 3D Digital Twins from Reality Mapping, capturing the real world as-is with Meshes, Point Clouds, True Orthos, and the newly released Gaussian Splats Layer. We’ll explore automated workflows for scalable asset monitoring and management, and how to integrate these reality-based layers with other geospatial and design data to drive deeper understanding and informed decision-making.

sessions.title: GeoAI Workflows with ArcGIS
sessions.description: Attend this session to learn about geospatial AI (GeoAI), the different types of geospatial machine learning and deep learning models, and how you can train and use them using the arcgis.learn module of ArcGIS API for Python and ArcGIS Pro. This session will showcase the application of ArcGIS’s GeoAI capabilities in the following areas: - Feature extraction from imagery and 3D data - Natural language processing of unstructured text - Clustering, prediction, and forecasting of feature, tabular, and time-series data

sessions.title: Geospatial Foundation Models and Embeddings
sessions.description: Geospatial foundation models offer new ways to learn from large, diverse, and often unlabeled geospatial datasets. This presentation explores how geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI) is evolving to integrate foundation models into analytical workflows. Topics include remote sensing foundation models, location embeddings, and geospatial vision-language models, with an overview of how Esri is working in this space. Speakers also discuss how embeddings work in geospatial analysis and the potential implications for environmental, urban, and other application areas.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Extracting Features Using GeoAI Models
sessions.description: Geospatial AI (GeoAI) is transforming the speed at which people extract meaning from complex datasets, helping them solve Earth's most pressing challenges. ArcGIS provides an easy-to-use solution for applying deep learning models to automate imagery workflows. Speakers cover the use of out-of-the-box tools and pretrained GeoAI models to accomplish advanced imagery workflows such as feature extraction, land-cover classification, and object identification. Learn how you can use GeoAI with ArcGIS Pro and the ArcGIS API for Python to quickly and easily extract key information from your imagery.

sessions.title: AI-Infused Development: Lessons Learned and Patterns from Esri Engineers
sessions.description: In this technical session, learn how Esri engineers are using AI to improve code quality, accelerate development and testing, simplify documentation, and explore new ideas. Learn about common AI-assisted development patterns, trade-offs between free and paid tools, and security considerations. Speakers review prompt-engineering basics and illustrate how AI can enhance your workflow with ArcGIS SDKs and ArcGIS APIs. You will leave with an understanding of how you can use AI effectively in real projects, what works and does not, and how to start applying AI in your own development process.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Building Trusted GeoAI with ArcGIS, Edge, and Local Inference
sessions.description: In this session, you will learn how to design and implement sovereign GeoAI architectures that combine ArcGIS capabilities with modern AI platforms, local inferencing, and edge-native operational workflows. Explore architectural patterns for building trusted enterprise AI systems that maintain operational control, data sovereignty, and offline resilience while integrating location intelligence into AI-driven applications, copilots, and autonomous agents. Attendees leave with solid architectural guidance for building secure, explainable, and operationally resilient GeoAI systems that scale.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps

sessions.title: Agentic AI and Spatial Grounding with ArcGIS
sessions.description: Explore how ArcGIS enables agentic AI through spatial grounding, providing the location context, tools, and workflows needed for trustworthy AI systems. Learn how agents and copilots can discover, access, and orchestrate geospatial knowledge, location services, and spatial analysis using modern integration patterns. Through live demonstrations and real-world scenarios, see what is possible today, where demand is emerging, and how organizations are applying ArcGIS to enterprise AI. Attendees should share perspectives and help shape the future of geospatial AI.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Velocity: An Overview
sessions.description: ArcGIS Velocity is a real-time analysis capability in ArcGIS Online, and coming soon to Enterprise, enabling organizations to ingest, visualize, analyze, store, and act upon data from Internet of Things (IoT) sensors. Join the discussion on how to connect to virtually any type of streaming data, perform real-time analytics and processing, and automatically disseminate information and alert personnel when specified conditions occur. Learn how to create analytic models to process high-volume historical data to gain insights into patterns, trends, and anomalies in your big data.

sessions.title: Getting Started with Real-Time Feeds in Your Applications
sessions.description: Apps that leverage real-time feeds enable a more engaging and dynamic experience for your users. ArcGIS natively supports ingest and analytics of feeds in our server products ArcGIS Velocity and GeoEvent Server, and developers can use the Maps SDKs and ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET to ingest, analyze, visualize and interact with feeds. Come to this session to get an overview of all of these ways of working with real-time feeds, so that you can bring them to life in your apps.

sessions.title: Spatial Data Science in ArcGIS
sessions.description: ArcGIS is a comprehensive analytics platform for data scientists. It enables you to unlock your data's full potential by integrating data exploration, statistical and machine learning algorithms, and advanced modeling techniques. Whether your analysis requires a powerful spatial data science workstation or a dynamic scripting environment, ArcGIS has you covered. In this session, you will learn about the analytic capabilities of ArcGIS, the key stages in any data science workflow, and how it all fits together.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Notebooks:  Automating Administration, Data Management, and Analysis
sessions.description: ArcGIS Notebooks in ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise provide various orchestration of tools, processes, and resources to automate administrative, data management, and analysis workflows. This session will detail the various techniques for scheduling notebook tasks, automating notebooks using webhooks, publishing notebooks as web tools, and calling notebooks programmatically via the ArcGIS API for Python.

sessions.title: Raster Analysis with ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python
sessions.description: This session explores the integration of map algebra with Python, highlighting how the ability to execute analytical tools in ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python has created new opportunities for raster analysis, data management, and workflow automation. Participants will be introduced to the Spatial Analyst, Image Analyst, and other modules relevant to raster analysis. Real-world examples will demonstrate best practices for using raster objects and classes to enhance modeling capabilities, optimize performance with raster functions, and explore various methods to extend analytical capabilities.

sessions.title: Intro to ArcGIS Knowledge Graphs & Extending with ArcGIS SDKs
sessions.description: Discover how ArcGIS Knowledge connects data into graph structures to uncover patterns, surface vulnerabilities, and spot hidden insights. This session covers graph model fundamentals, analytics tools, and how to build and explore graphs in ArcGIS Pro. Then learn at a high level how to extend graph-powered workflows with developer tools, focusing on the ArcGIS API for Python and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript.

sessions.title: ArcGIS GeoAnalytics: Big Data and Spatial Analysis
sessions.description: ArcGIS GeoAnalytics Engine is a developer solution for analyzing large spatial datasets in your Apache Spark environment. It's a Python-based analytics library that lets you aggregate, analyze, and build big data workflows with PySpark, in cloud-native or self-hosted environments. With the 2.0 release, it also supports raster analysis, making it an even more powerful tool. Learn how you can leverage the power of Spark for your spatial analysis use case, plus cloud-native geospatial formats like GeoParquet and other aspects of big data analysis.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Dashboards: Extending with ArcGIS Arcade
sessions.description: A dashboard is a view of geographic information and data that allows you to monitor events, make decisions, inform others, and see trends. A robust suite of configuration options allows you to display multiple visualizations that work together on a single screen. But what if your data isn't quite right, or you can't get a visualization to look exactly how you want it? In this session, you will learn how to leverage attribute expressions, data expressions and formatting expressions to combine, model, and enhance your data in ways that allow you to unlock to full potential of your dashboards.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Experience Builder: An Overview
sessions.description: Quickly transform your data into interactive web apps and web pages you envision with low to no code. ArcGIS Experience Builder provides a new level of configuration with flexible design, smart widgets, mobile optimization, Arcade expressions, and integrations. When needed, build custom tools using the developer edition. In this presentation, learn about the building blocks of Experience Builder and how they work together, and discover the roadmap — including how AI will enhance and streamline your app-building experience.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Experience Builder: Advanced Customization
sessions.description: Join us to explore advanced solutions with the developer edition of ArcGIS Experience Builder. In this technical session, speakers cover deeper topics for building custom widgets, including widget communication, data sources, automated deployments, custom widget source code collaboration, connecting to the Map component from ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, and more.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Experience Builder: Tips and Tricks for Designing and Building Exciting Apps
sessions.description: Join us for an action-packed session to discover the hidden gems of ArcGIS Experience Builder design framework. Whether you're a seasoned pro or just getting started, this talk will provide you with practical, time-saving tips and tricks to supercharge your workflows. Learn how to properly size and position elements, choose color palettes that pop, use ArcGIS Arcade expressions for advanced formatting, and customize your apps to truly stand out. We'll also show you how to customize themes, integrate Calcite Components and unlock the full potential of ArcGIS Experience Builder with Developer Edition.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Instant Apps: What's New, Coming and AI Data Explorer Template
sessions.description: If you are looking to quickly transform your maps into interactive, focused web apps and meet different purposes of your work without a single line of code, ArcGIS Instant Apps is a great solution for you. In this session, presenters will discuss several new and enhanced templates and features that were added to Instant Apps, including Reporter and Manager template, and adding multilingual features for greater accessibility. Presenters also discuss what’s to come, including the upcoming Data Explorer template that utilizes national language to help your users understand the data on the map.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Field Maps: Advanced Workflows with Arcade
sessions.description: Arcade expressions allow you to break free of your data model and derive new information from your data on the fly, whether it’s by providing greater situational awareness with adaptive popups, applying conditional visibility or calculations to your forms, contextually labeling your features, or dynamically visualizing them on the map. Join this session to deepen your Arcade knowledge within ArcGIS Field Maps and take your mobile workflows to the next level.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Survey123: Extending Through AI, Machine Learning, and the JavaScript API
sessions.description: "In this session, we will begin by exploring the latest features of Survey123 and showcasing how they empower users in their data collection efforts. We will delve into leveraging the report engine of to create professional and customized reports. Furthermore, if you are a web developer seeking to integrate Survey123 forms within your apps, this session is for you. Learn valuable insights on loading forms into your app, setting values and properties within the form, and responding to form events using the Survey123 Web App JavaScript API."

sessions.title: ArcGIS Field Maps: Integration & Automation
sessions.description: Super charge your field operations through automation and integration with ArcGIS Field Maps and Survey123! This session will cover how to utilize powerful tools and techniques, like Python scripting and Power Automate, to minimize repetition and manual work, optimize workflows, and leverage the capabilities of GIS across your organization.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Survey123: Unlocking AI in Survey
sessions.description: Discover how AI can be integrated into ArcGIS Survey123 to streamline workflows, improve data quality, and enhance field operations. Learn how ready-to-use AI models support tasks such as smart photo redaction for privacy protection. We will also introduce the creation and deployment of custom AI models for image classification, object detection, and organization-specific workflows. Finally, explore the new AI Assistant in Survey123 Web Designer and see how natural language can accelerate form creation and simplify survey design.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: What's New
sessions.description: ArcGIS Enterprise is always evolving and advancing to support data management, mapping and visualization, analysis, operations, collaboration, and sharing. Join us at this session for details and demos on recent enhancements and exciting new features in the product that have been added in the latest releases. Learn how you can take advantage of these new capabilities in your own organization to advance and expand your use of ArcGIS Enterprise.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: Automation with Hosted Notebooks
sessions.description: ArcGIS Notebooks provides a range of options for automating workflows, allowing you to streamline your processes. In this session, we will explore the different use cases for automation and implementation. We will cover scheduling notebooks to run at specific times, triggering notebook runs using webhooks, publishing notebooks as web tools, and programmatically executing notebooks using the ArcGIS API for Python. You will leave this session with a comprehensive understanding of how to leverage these automation methods in ArcGIS Notebooks to optimize your workflows and enhance productivity.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: An Introduction for Developers
sessions.description: ArcGIS Enterprise provides comprehensive functionality for mapping, visualization, analytics, data management, and geospatial applications. It is used by all types of users of all experience levels. Specifically for developers, it provides a robust launching point for automation, customization, extensibility, and app-building. This technical session covers an introduction to ArcGIS Enterprise and reviews the APIs that you can use to script and automate workflows, the ArcGIS Enterprise SDK for extending services, and related products and components to take Enterprise to the next level.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise on Kubernetes
sessions.description: ArcGIS Enterprise on Kubernetes: Around the world, adoption of Kubernetes is accelerating thanks to its scalability, resilience, and improved manageability. In 2021, Esri launched ArcGIS Enterprise on Kubernetes, fully redesigned into a cloud-native architecture. If you’ve been wondering how to simplify deployments and upgrades, how to monitor performance and optimize system resources, how to scale services quickly and how to manage your GIS data in a cloud-native environment, you will want to attend this session!

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: Data Storage Strategies
sessions.description: Data is an integral part of ArcGIS, providing the foundation for your mapping, analysis, and decision-making workflows. Where you store your data impacts how you access, edit, validate, secure, and scale it. This session will highlight the storage options available to you in ArcGIS, from the ArcGIS Data Store and enterprise geodatabases to cloud storage and cloud data warehouses. The intent of this session is to give attendees a high-level understanding of the data storage landscape in ArcGIS Enterprise and how you can leverage these different storage options in your own organization.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: Security Best Practices
sessions.description: This session will share best practices for securing your ArcGIS Enterprise deployments. Learn how to protect yourself from common threats and attacks and how to harden your environment using multiple layers of security. This session will cover environmental aspects, including the operating system, accounts, databases, networks, and firewalls. Join us to learn about security options in ArcGIS Enterprise that help protect your site from attack.

sessions.title: A Mid-Sized City's Playbook for Effective, Adopted GIS Strategy
sessions.description: Kaunas needed a smart, data-driven general plan—but its GIS was fragmented, distrusted, and barely used. This session shares how a mid-sized city rebuilt spatial decision-making from the ground up in one year, turning isolated tools into one integrated ArcGIS ecosystem now serving 250+ users across 10 departments. You'll get a practical 10-action framework—covering data foundation, governance, adoption, and strategic plan monitoring with ~30 urban indicators—that any municipality or organization can reuse to move from tools nobody uses to systems that drive real decisions.

sessions.title: Extending ArcGIS Enterprise with Custom Data Feeds
sessions.description: Learn how to use powerful developer technologies to integrate data with ArcGIS Enterprise. Custom data feeds allows users to expose their data as an input for feature services with optional write capability. Potential input data include, but are not limited to, user-managed data stores not natively supported by ArcGIS clients.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Monitor: Observability in Practice
sessions.description: Effectively managing and operating systems requires that staff and responsible teams have access to information about how the systems are running. This is referred to as the observability of a system, and well-architected systems take observability seriously. In this session we will look at observing ArcGIS systems in practice using ArcGIS Monitor, a comprehensive tool designed to collect, analyze, and optimize the health of your enterprise GIS system and its underlying infrastructure. Come see what ArcGIS Monitor can do!

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: Cloud Deployment Options and Cloud-Native Services
sessions.description: Discover the automation that you can take advantage of to deploy ArcGIS Enterprise in the cloud using Esri’s latest tooling and applications. After you have learned about the different ways that you can deploy ArcGIS Enterprise in the cloud, speakers explore how to integrate your GIS workflows with cloud-native storage solutions like object storage, database as a service, and cloud data warehouse offerings.
products: ArcGIS Enterprise on Amazon Web Services

sessions.title: Extending ArcGIS Enterprise with Webhooks
sessions.description: Learn how to use powerful developer technologies to extend ArcGIS Enterprise through webhooks. Webhooks offer deep integration within ArcGIS Enterprise through event-driven notifications in both the portal as well as feature services and geoprocessing services. Join us to explore how items, users, and group modification along with feature service edits trigger a webhook and the different ways to respond to these notifications.

sessions.title: Upgrading ArcGIS Enterprise
sessions.description: Planning ahead when upgrading to a new release of ArcGIS Enterprise allows you to take advantage of new features and capabilities, stability enhancements, and improved functionality with ease. This technical session covers how to efficiently and effectively upgrade your deployment, including the steps to take before, during, and after an upgrade so that you can approach upgrades with confidence.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS REST API: Full Throttle
sessions.description: In Web GIS, all resources are published as web services. While ArcGIS APIs/SDKs are to a large degree wrappers around the REST API, allowing you to access these web services following the conventions of the platform you're working with, you always still have access to the REST API for accessing web services directly. In this session, we will demonstrate to you the best practice techniques for working with the REST API when combining the REST API to a third API.

sessions.title: Security and Authentication for Custom Applications
sessions.description: Learn about the different security options available for accessing Esri's secured authoritative content, ArcGIS Location Services, spatial analysis, and your hosted content in your applications. Speakers cover API key authentication, user authentication, and app credential authentication using ArcGIS APIs and SDKs.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Location Platform: An Overview for Developers
sessions.description: ArcGIS Location Platform is a geospatial platform as a service (PaaS) for developers who are looking to integrate location capabilities into their apps, business systems, and products. It enables developers to create apps and extend ArcGIS functionality using ArcGIS APIs, SDKs and tools. In this technical session, speakers discuss what's new and what's different between ArcGIS Location Platform and ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Enterprise when developing apps and how your organization might benefit from it.

sessions.title: Vector Tile Style Editor: Deep Customization of ArcGIS Basemaps
sessions.description: Learn how to customize the ArcGIS vector basemaps to showcase your data and meet your applications and your customers' needs. Explore advanced features like direct JSON editing to customize layers and merge datasets together into the perfect basemap.

sessions.title: Developer Collaboration with Git and GitHub
sessions.description: GitHub is a great collaboration tool and this technical session covers the basics of its version control system (git) using examples that do not require any experience writing code. Speakers also talk about how Esri uses GitHub features for managing projects and how you can get involved with Esri's open-source projects.

sessions.title: Building Beautiful Interactive Mapping Applications with ArcGIS Basemap Services
sessions.description: Learn about the new enhancements and capabilities of ArcGIS Basemap services, such as the new styles and how to use preferences such as language labels, basemap places, and worldview borders. Create better applications and learn how to maximize your mapping experience by using basemaps to help support user interactivity and interactions with the map itself.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Online: Best Practices with Hosted Feature Services
sessions.description: In this session, you will learn how to make effective use of Hosted Feature Services in your apps. Learn how to take advantage of the feature service REST API to make your app more performant, more resilient, and more reliable. You will also learn about the recommended workflows for updating, editing, and syncing feature service data. Future direction of online feature service will also be presented.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Online: Developing with Web Maps and Web Scenes
sessions.description: Join this session to learn how to develop in ArcGIS Online as a GIS developer. You don't need to write 500 lines of code - you can build the basics in Map Viewer and then add custom interactivity into your app with focused code. We'll cover how to build web apps, how to register them, how to share them, and how to secure them using the ArcGIS security model.

sessions.title: Working with Hosted Feature Layer Views
sessions.description: Hosted feature layer views allow you to create multiple unique windows into your data and customize them to fit your audience. In this session, learn how hosted feature layer views can be used to meet audience needs while ensuring data integrity and privacy.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Online: Best Practices for High Performance Web Apps
sessions.description: Join us in this session to learn the essentials of building and maintaining viral web applications. We'll discuss efficient data management, seamless user interactions, and effective tracking and analysis of user engagement to boost app performance. Discover best practices for creating intuitive, responsive views that captivate your audience. Master high frequency data updates to keep your application dynamic. By the end, you'll gain practical knowledge and strategies to elevate your web applications immediately.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Pro: Tools for Diagnosing Issues and Troubleshooting
sessions.description: ArcGIS Pro has provided the Diagnostic Monitor for quite some time. Now that the Help ribbon is easier to find, we want to show you how to gather some details about your work with ArcGIS Pro and where you could optimize it. We will also discuss other tools like the ArcGIS Pro Performance Assessment Tool (PAT).

sessions.title: ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET: Patterns of Extensibility
sessions.description: This beginner-level session will cover fundamental approaches for extending ArcGIS Pro, covering select SDK and Pro API topic areas. We’ll discuss practical considerations for your add-ins and online resources for your work, including support for Visual Studio Code and AI.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET: Getting Started with Copilot-Assisted Development
sessions.description: Discover how to leverage the power of AI and Agentic AI in your ArcGIS Pro Add-in development using GitHub Copilot from within Visual Studio Code. We will discuss the use of Agentic AI and GitHub Copilot to assist with code completion and many other useful features.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET: Copilot-Supported Add-in Development
sessions.description: Join us for an immersive session where we use Agentic AI and GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code to create a real-world ArcGIS Pro Add-in project from start to finish. We will use Copilot to create the addin and to help us write the code needed for our GIS workflow.

sessions.title: Version Management with ArcGIS
sessions.description: This session will present some of the technical details behind the branch versioning model that was developed for ArcGIS Pro and ArcGIS Enterprise. We will review the ArcGIS Pro user experience and the database structures that support these capabilities.

sessions.title: Attribute Rules: A Deep Dive
sessions.description: This session focuses on best practices when deploying Attribute Rules on enterprise systems. Learn how to identify and fix slow running rules in the entire stack, run-away recursive attribute rules, attribute rule execution during branch versioning reconcile, client side execution of attribute rules and more.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Data Pipelines: Empowering Developers for Data Engineering
sessions.description: Join us to learn about no-code data engineering and automation with ArcGIS Data Pipelines. We'll share how Data Pipelines can help process and manipulate data from a variety of sources, maintain application data, and deliver efficient and scalable data integration solutions in your ArcGIS organizations.

sessions.title: Understanding the Utility Network
sessions.description: This session will dive into the utility network. We will discuss how the data works and we will cover the APIs, SDKs, and out-of-the-box customizability that is supported. We will demonstrate the opportunities for developers to leverage different SDKs to work with network management in ArcGIS. We will explore the access and customizations available across the entire ArcGIS Platform and how we can build products that deliver significant business value for customers .

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Game Engines: An Introduction
sessions.description: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Game Engines enable you to build next generation immersive 3D and XR apps with real-world spatial data. In this session we will introduce the ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Unity and Unreal Engine, provide an overview of the capabilities, and demonstrate how to get started with the SDKs. You will also learn about how these game engine plug-ins are being used today to build applications for a range of industries from AEC to public safety.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Game Engines: Building Immersive Apps
sessions.description: Interested in building a digital twin with ArcGIS and bringing it to life in a game engine? This session walks through the hands-on process of preparing, optimizing, and using ArcGIS data in a game engine to create an interactive, living geospatial digital twin. You’ll learn what types of GIS content are supported, how to prepare 3D data such as meshes, scenes, and CityEngine models, and ways to combine them with game engine assets and effects. Also explore techniques for enhancing immersive 3D and XR experiences with interactivity, animation, and physics - while keeping performance in check.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDK for Unreal Engine

sessions.title: Built-in Client Capabilities for Dynamic, Tiled, and Oriented Imagery
sessions.description: Learn how to use and offer interactivity and flexibility with imagery in Esri clients, app templates and customized web clients and make use of the capabilities embedded in the wide variety of imagery data models for visualization and analysis. These include datasets such as Mosaic, Catalog, Oriented Imagery, Raster Collections, Multi-Dimensional Imagecubes, LIDAR/LAS Datasets, and 3D Meshes.

sessions.title: Managing Imagery Layers Using the ArcGIS API for Python
sessions.description: This session offers a deep dive into imagery layer management within ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online using the ArcGIS API for Python. Attendees will discover efficient, scalable workflows for updating and automating imagery content management.

sessions.title: ArcGIS: Automating Reality Mapping Workflows Using Python
sessions.description: In this technical session, learn how to process and create reality mapping products using ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python. This session introduces the geoprocessing tools and ArcGIS API functions used to create reality mapping products. Specifically, this session demonstrates how to use ArcPy and ArcGIS API for Python to automate the production of DSM, DTM, True Ortho, Point Cloud, Mesh and Gaussian Splats from various sources, including drone, aerial, and satellite images.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Arcade: Fundamentals
sessions.description: ArcGIS Arcade is a simple but powerful expression language developed by Esri to support multiple ArcGIS geospatial workflows, and is used in apps across the ArcGIS system. Arcade provides a library of functions to examine spatial relationships, clean up and convert data, visualize features dynamically on a map, format pop-ups using multiple layers, calculate field values, constrain form input values, and more. Come to this session to get a solid understanding of Arcade fundamentals and see a variety of examples of how it can be used to enhance ArcGIS workflows.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Data Integration: Streamlining Your Data Flow from Source to ArcGIS
sessions.description: ArcGIS is a system that allows for integration of many types of data - but what is the best approach to get data out of one system and into ArcGIS Online or ArcGIS Enterprise so that you can leverage it in your apps? Join us to survey various data integration strategies available in ArcGIS. We'll cover methods such as scripting, ETL, and direct read. You will leave with new strategies to streamline your own data flow process.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Enterprise: Low to No Downtime Upgrades
sessions.description: Discover how to upgrade ArcGIS Enterprise with minimal disruption using a blue-green deployment approach. This session will demonstrate how to leverage WebGIS DR and a secondary environment to perform seamless upgrades, ensuring business continuity and reducing risk. Learn the step-by-step process, best practices, and key considerations for executing upgrades with little to no downtime.

sessions.title: ArcGIS: Exploring Tools and Patterns for Data Migration
sessions.description: ArcGIS offers a variety of tools to ingest and transform diverse data types as they move into the system. This session explores both the overarching principles and practical examples of extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows. Presenters will demonstrate approaches using core geoprocessing tools, the ArcGIS Data Interoperability extension, the ArcGIS Data Pipelines app, and Python notebooks leveraging ArcPy, the ArGIS API for Python and other Python modules in the notebook runtimes for those who prefer code-driven solutions.

sessions.title: Understanding MCP and A2A: A Primer for GIS Practitioners
sessions.description: As AI technologies evolve, new protocols are emerging to support intelligent system-to-system communication. This session introduces GIS professionals to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and A2A (Agent-to-Agent Protocol), two foundational standards enabling agentic AI workflows. Attendees will gain a high-level understanding of how these protocols work, why they matter, and how they may shape the future of geospatial problem-solving.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps: Overview and What's New
sessions.description: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps let you build powerful mapping applications with .NET, Flutter, Kotlin, Qt, and Swift that integrate with the ArcGIS system and run directly on desktop or mobile devices, online or offline. Over the past year, several enhancements have been introduced, such as more flexible editing capabilities, improved handling of real-time data, and support for new data sources such as geospatial PDFs. This session will introduce the SDKs and showcase the latest improvements.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps: Feature Editing and Offline Workflows
sessions.description: The Native Maps SDKs are built from the ground up to provide an exceptional offline experience. We will explore offline patterns, the capabilities available while offline, and the data types that support these capabilities. Topics will cover ahead-of-time and on-demand options for generating, editing, and updating GIS data, utilizing both SaaS and self-hosted ArcGIS services, along with desktop-based workflows using ArcGIS Pro. This session is for new users who aim to create successful and scalable solutions for field operations and those looking to optimize their deployed solutions.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET: Advanced Workflows
sessions.description: In this session we will discuss advanced topics such as building ArcGIS Maps SDK for .NET applications using MVVM patterns, migrating from .NET Framework and UWP, cross-platform authentication workflows, and exploring UI tools available to develop consistent looking cross-platform applications. In addition, we'll present various tips and tricks to boost your productivity and make your applications more robust and improve performance.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps: Real-time Situational Awareness
sessions.description: Integrating real-time feeds, analyzing and visualizing data, and alerting are key to real-time situational awareness apps. The Dynamic Entities API provides a framework for visualizing, processing, and analyzing real-time data feeds, the Geotriggers API allows you to setup notifications for geofence-based incident detection, and the new raster analytics API performs fast visibility calculations. This session will give an overview of these APIs and show examples of how to ingest feeds, work with Dynamic Entities, visualize and interact with them as tracks, and build custom automated behaviors.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps

sessions.title: Strategies for Mobile and Desktop App Development
sessions.description: Join this session if you are interested in developing specialized mobile and desktop GIS applications for your organization and need assistance in selecting the right technology. We will cover ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps for building custom 2D and 3D mapping applications, ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Game Engines which leverage game engines for enhanced rendering capabilities, and ArcGIS Pro SDK for .NET which provides the framework for extending the functionality of the ArcGIS Pro desktop GIS software.
products: ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps
ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Game Engines

sessions.title: Strategies for Scripting and Automating with Python
sessions.description: Python is the language of ArcGIS, used for creating tools and automating processes and models for performing analysis and managing data, through the ArcGIS Pro interface, in Notebooks, and as standalone scripts, on desktops, on your servers, or on ArcGIS Online. Python is quite flexible in its ability to combine ArcPy and the ArcGIS API for Python with thousands of other packages, available in the Anaconda repository and elsewhere. Also covered will be the full set of resources available to developers for success: samples, open source projects, training, videos, and community forums.

sessions.title: Level Up your ArcGIS Python Skills
sessions.description: Python is a powerful open source programming language that you can use across the ArcGIS system. Though the language is easy to learn, the huge variety of packages and tools means people use it in vastly different ways. Come to this presentation to learn a few things we think everybody really needs to know to be more awesome at Python. We'll cover the extensive distribution included with ArcGIS products, effective use of JupyterLab, debugging with VS Code, scaling your code, and best practices for using LLMs.

sessions.title: Content Management Using ArcGIS API for Python: Cloning and Migrating Content
sessions.description: Moving content between organizations is a fundamental task confronted by Web GIS managers. The ArcGIS API for Python provides a variety of options for doing so based on the specifics of your organization and your desired workflow. In this session, we’ll establish some standard terms around cloning, migration, and promotion, take a deep dive into how the clone_items() method works, and briefly discuss migrating group content. We’ll conclude with best practices for working with specific item types and troubleshooting strategies when items may not clone or migrate as expected.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS API for Python: Administering Your Web GIS
sessions.description: This technical session will teach GIS administrators how to use the ArcGIS API for Python to manage their Web GIS and automate common repetitive tasks. We will cover common administrative workflows for managing users, their credits and licenses, and groups and content. We’ll also cover different security aspects such as authentication schemes, login profiles, and API keys, as well as strategies for managing data stores and administering GIS servers. Additionally, we’ll discuss automation concepts such as webhooks and on-demand execution of notebooks.

sessions.title: Creating and Using Web Tools and GP Services
sessions.description: Geoprocessing tools provide an integrated and familiar experience for analysts to perform data management and spatial analysis in ArcGIS. With a geoprocessing tool, others can reuse your methods and workflows with their own data without needing to learn or use code. This session will show you how to create and design geoprocessing tools, choose appropriate parameters, write custom Python validation routines to fine-tune the user experience, and author help so the tool can be used correctly by others. Approaches for debugging, error handling and messaging using Python will also be covered.

sessions.title: ArcGIS API for Python: Managing Web Maps and Layers
sessions.description: This technical session will demonstrate how to use the ArcGIS API for Python to author, edit, and visualize web maps and web layers. We will demonstrate some common workflows including editing pop-ups, group layers, switching basemaps and layers, and finally cloning GIS content.

sessions.title: The ArcGIS Well-Architected Framework: An Overview
sessions.description: Ready to take your GIS architecture to the next level? This session introduces the ArcGIS Well-Architected Framework and Architecture Center to help IT and GIS professionals apply proven strategies for designing, deploying, and optimizing enterprise-class GIS systems. Learn to evaluate your architecture, align with system patterns, and implement best practices for scalability, performance, and resilience. Whether refining an existing deployment or planning new, gain actionable insights for building smarter GIS infrastructure.

sessions.title: Designing and Implementing Well-Architected Systems
sessions.description: The ArcGIS Well-Architected Framework introduces the concepts of system patterns and architecture practices as key inputs to an architecture design process, but how do you actually apply these concepts to a system that you need to design? Join us to explore how to use and build on the ArcGIS system patterns and learn how to apply architectural pillars to your design to ensure that you are considering the right options, aligning to your organization's goals, and building a resilient, capable system that will encourage adoption.

sessions.title: Integrating ArcGIS with Other Business Systems
sessions.description: Realizing the full potential of ArcGIS across your organization or enterprise often demands that your ArcGIS systems are integrated with other business systems, such as EAM, CRM, CAMA, and ERP systems. ArcGIS supports a variety of integration approaches and methods, as well as provides native integration solutions for specific software and system providers. In this session we will review common, high-level approaches to integrating ArcGIS with other business systems, as well as explore specific, technical integration patterns at the application, services, and data tier.

sessions.title: Authentication: A Practical Approach to Security in ArcGIS
sessions.description: Two main authentication mechanisms exist for applications built with ArcGIS services. API keys allow quick access to popular locations services, and ArcGIS Identities provide access to private user and organization content for richer experiences. This session will cover the key differences and use cases between these approaches and how to integrate each into your applications.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise: Deployment Patterns and Practices
sessions.description: It is a common misconception that an organization should use either ArcGIS Enterprise or ArcGIS Online, when in fact many organizations successfully use both. This session will cover how to choose the deployment that best fits your organizational needs. We will talk about the different forms of hybrid patterns that best take advantage of each environment’s unique strengths to build the best possible system and help you plan.

sessions.title: ArcGIS in a Sovereign Resilient Architecture
sessions.description: In Europe, digital sovereignty is becoming increasingly important. What choices can be made to ensure ArcGIS fits within a more sovereign architecture? In this session, Jeroen van Winden will discuss what digital sovereignty entails and how ArcGIS can be implemented, considering sovereignty, resiliency, and other factors.

sessions.title: Best Practices for Scalable, Mission-Critical Systems
sessions.description: In this technical session, speakers share proven approaches for designing, building, and sustaining mission‑critical systems deployed across ArcGIS Online and ArcGIS Enterprise. Topics will cover the full system life cycle, from implementation through long‑term operations, as well as the core pillars of the ArcGIS Well‑Architected Framework, including reliability, performance, and scalability. Attendees will also gain insight into the people and process considerations that complement technical decisions, helping teams deliver resilient, high-performing systems that meet mission needs.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: What’s New
sessions.description: Attend this session to get a tour of the most important advancements in the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript that were introduced over the last year, and get inspired with new ideas for your web apps. You'll also get a taste for what other sessions will cover, which will help you plan your week at the conference.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: App Development with Components—Programming Patterns
sessions.description: This is the first session in a 4-part series and is critical for anyone building apps with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript as it will introduce the core concepts and programming patterns for building apps with the SDK's web components. This evolution of the SDK introduces a new way to build web apps which maximizes productivity and is the recommended pattern for all applications. We'll cover map components (which includes the map, scene, and functionality equivalent to legacy widgets), as well as charts and coding components.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: App Development with Components—Using Frameworks
sessions.description: Join us for the second session in our 4-part series on building applications with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. We will begin with exploring motivations for using frontend frameworks, and then cover techniques for integrating the SDK's web components with frameworks and tools such as React and Vite. We will touch on current frontend methodologies for topics such as dependency management, asset management, semantic versioning, prebuilt vs. built applications that scale, and conveniences offered by frameworks that streamline web mapping app development compared to plain JavaScript.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: App Development with Components—User Experience
sessions.description: Join us for the third session in our 4-part series on building applications with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. This session is focused on building the user experience in your web app with the SDK's components and Calcite Design System. Calcite provides a library of patterns, icons, and user-friendly, configurable web components that enable developers to easily build responsive, accessible web applications. We'll demonstrate how the components can be used together to build intuitive yet powerful experiences in your apps.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: App Development with Components—Extending and Styling
sessions.description: Join us for the fourth session in our 4-part series on building applications with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. In this session we'll showcase branding and styling strategies to create rich theming and customization in your apps using Calcite design tokens and ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript component tokens. We'll also explore how you can use light and dark modes to your app that will apply to both Calcite and SDK components. Finally, learn how you can use component slots for integrating your custom workflows and further tune your app's UI/UX.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: Building AI Assistants
sessions.description: Learn how you can build an AI assistant for a web application using the framework being developed in the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. We'll discuss key terminology, how to use the components and out-of-the-box workflows built in to the SDK, how to define your own workflows specific to your application, and how to leverage the client-side capabilities of the browser and the SDK to make the best possible experience for your users.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: From Raw Data to Custom App: Data Engineering, Mapping, and Web Development
sessions.description: Join this dynamic session where presenters will build applications from the ground up. Starting with raw data, they will demonstrate how you can automate data ingestion into ArcGIS Online, then cover key techniques for creating and managing a service, next authoring the web map including cartography tips and tricks, and finally, building a custom web app from scratch with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript that uses the web map as the starting point to drive the visualization and experience around the data.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: Dynamic, Data-driven Visualization
sessions.description: Learn the basics of how to turn your raw data into information that tells a story with data-driven visualizations. This session will provide an overview to the various visualization techniques available in the API specific to vector data. You will also learn tips and tricks to help you feel more confident in making smart choices for visualizing your data.

sessions.title: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript: Using Vite for Building Fast, Dynamic Web Apps
sessions.description: This session will explore a case study on how Esri's development teams are leveraging modern tools like Vite to build fast, dynamic Web GIS applications. With features such as lazy loading, client-side routing, hot module replacement, and lightning-fast builds, Vite streamlines the entire development workflow from bundling to deployment. Paired with Vitest for testing, these tools help ensure that your apps are both high-performing and production-ready.

sessions.title: High-Performance Spatial Data on the Web: Feature Layers and Parquet Layers
sessions.description: Feature layers are the best way to work with feature data on the web. In this session, we'll discuss and demonstrate techniques for optimizing performance in custom web applications built with the ArcGIS Maps SDk for JavaScript, from service configuration and caching to client-side queries and filtering. We'll also introduce Parquet feature layers, explore the scenarios where they excel, compare their capabilities with Feature layers, and share best practices for building high-performance web applications with large spatial datasets.

room.name: Harmonie Hall D-E—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Strategies for Web Development
sessions.description: Attend this session if you are new to creating web apps and interested in learning about ArcGIS technology to build web apps. We will introduce key components of the web architecture, how you can create dynamic 2D and 3D maps that are shared between apps, and cover configurable apps and low-code solutions for easy app creation. We will also explore web components and JavaScript libraries available to develop custom apps. Finally, versatile web services, ready-to-use location services and patterns to support your web apps on the data side.

room.name: Harmonie Hall A-C—Level C2 | Congress Center

sessions.title: Building Web Apps with Open Source Mapping APIs
sessions.description: Learn the main differences between the most popular open-source mapping APIs such as Leaflet, OpenLayers, and Maplibre GL JS and how to integrate them with ArcGIS services such as basemaps, routing, geocoding and vector tiles with the help of ArcGIS REST JS.

sessions.title: Tools for the Modern Web Developer
sessions.description: There are many tools to assist developing frontend web apps. Come hear about some of our favorites and how they can help you become a better, more efficient developer.

sessions.title: Working with ArcGIS REST JS
sessions.description: ArcGIS REST JS is an open-source, compact, and easy-to-use wrapper around the ArcGIS REST APIs that simplifies working with these services in any TypeScript or JavaScript application. Learn how to integrate ArcGIS services such as routing, geocoding, demographic and feature layers into your Node.js and browser applications. We’ll also show how to use ArcGIS REST JS to manage your organization’s content, users, and groups.

sessions.title: European Developer & Technology Summit Plenary: Part 2
sessions.description: This second part of the Plenary Session covers how ArcGIS continues to evolve its leveraging of the growing capabilities of AI. This includes the spatial data models and tools that we call geospatial artificial intelligence (GeoAI), the role of AI assistants in apps and developer components, as well as how designers and developers can build solutions that use agentic AI.

sessions.title: European Developer & Technology Summit Plenary: Part 3
sessions.description: The plenary concludes with coverage of new products, tools, capabilities, and techniques for developers who build apps, extend ArcGIS desktop and server software and services, and use scripting for creating and automating workflows.
