sessions.title: From Complexity to Productivity: User-Centered GIS for Network Planning
sessions.description: Network planning often involves complex workflows, multiple systems, and manual effort. This session shows how an ArcGIS-based solution for an Austrian energy supplier simplifies daily planning through user-centered workflows. Guided processes, workflow automation, integrated planning capabilities, and seamless editing help reduce complexity, improve data quality, and increase efficiency. Real-world examples demonstrate how planners are supported from the initial idea to implementation, accelerating planning and boosting productivity.

sessions.title: Migrating ArcGIS Server Extensions to the 21st Century
sessions.description: ArcGIS Enterprise 11 retires the ArcMap runtime and legacy .NET Framework 4 server extensions, so we migrated our SOEs/SOIs to the ArcGIS Pro runtime and modern .NET 8, fixing everything around them. Project files went from 135 lines to 7. Package versions live in one place. No DLL hell for extensions sharing a service. Deployment stopped being a manual checklist. A build now stamps an automated version ArcGIS will show you. The CI/CD runs on Linux, where ArcGIS Server itself may one day follow. Live demo of a custom admin portal we run the site from, and a closing word on AI coding agents.

sessions.title: Run Your GIS Like a Product: Why Foundational Data Drives Business Value
sessions.description: Many GIS programs struggle to demonstrate business impact because they are managed as support functions rather than products. The most successful GIS organizations take a different approach. They continuously deliver capabilities that create measurable value across the enterprise. Foundational data sits at the core of this approach. In this session, we'll explore how product management principles can help GIS teams align services with organizational priorities, increase adoption and build stronger business cases for investment.

speakers.name: Michael Branscomb
speakers.bio: Mike Branscomb is a Product Manager at Esri working on the Game Engine Maps SDKs and Native Maps SDKs. He has spent many years helping developers build geospatial applications and is passionate about providing the best possible tools for creating 2D, 3D, and immersive experiences. Mike also brings years of Scrum Product Owner experience, helping cross-functional teams turn ideas into high-quality products that solve real user needs.

speakers.name: Trevor Draeseke
speakers.bio: Trevor Draeseke is a Product Engineer and Product Owner specializing in labeling in the ArcGIS Maps SDK. Trevor's passion for mapping and geographic information systems began during their tenure as a maritime archaeologist, where they first recognized the power of spatial data on understanding our world - past and present!

speakers.name: Rich Ruh
speakers.bio: Rich Ruh is a Product Engineer at Esri, responsible for geodatabase and utility network developer APIs for the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Native Apps, ArcGIS Pro, and ArcGIS Enterprise. Prior to joining Esri in 2014, Rich worked in the partner community for 14 years, using Esri developer technology to build products for the utility industry.

speakers.name: Uma Harano
speakers.bio: Uma Harano is a Senior Principle Product Engineer on the ArcGIS Pro SDK team, specializing in helping customers extend the capabilities of ArcGIS Pro through custom workflows. She is passionate about harnessing the power of GIS technology to enable developer customization and drive innovative solutions. Outside of her work with the SDK, Uma enjoys exploring National Parks, reading, playing the piano, and spending time with friends and family.

speakers.name: Kristian Ekenes
speakers.bio: Kristian Ekenes is a Principal Product Engineer at Esri. He contributes to the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, ArcGIS Arcade, and Map Viewer. Kristian has worked on researching and developing innovative data visualization capabilities for web maps and the Arcade language since 2015. Currently, he leads the effort to bring AI components and client-side agents to the JS Maps SDK. Kristian is passionate about helping others explore and discover hidden stories in raw data through the powerful visual capabilities of Web GIS.

speakers.name: Julie Powell
speakers.bio: Julie Powell is a Senior Principal Product Manager at Esri, focusing on ArcGIS web development technologies, including ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript and Calcite Design System. Julie works to inspire the developer community while guiding the product vision and the technical road map.

speakers.name: Suzanne Foss
speakers.bio: Suzanne is the Product Manager for Spatial Analytics & Data Science capabilities in ArcGIS. She has worked in the geographic information systems industry for over 17 years with a focus on location intelligence, spatiotemporal analysis, model building, and workflow/process automation.

speakers.name: Euan Cameron
speakers.bio: Euan Cameron is Chief Technology Officer of Developer Technology at Esri. With more than 35 years in geospatial software, he has helped shape innovative mapping and analytics products while championing robust, intuitive APIs. A frequent international speaker, he shares insights on API design and geospatial technology. Outside work, Euan and his wife, Julie, enjoy climbing, skiing, and hiking in the Sierra Nevada Mountains.

speakers.name: David Cardella
speakers.bio: David Cardell is a seasoned Product Management Director for Developer Technologies and Analytics. With over three decades of experience bridging the worlds of development, data, and business strategy, he brings a rare blend of technical depth and leadership insight.

speakers.name: Gerhard "Luigi" Trichtl
speakers.bio: Gerhard Trichtl has worked several decades at the Austrian/Slovakia Distributor in Vienna in the range of Consulting, Professional Service, Support, Testing, and Training across the Esri products

speakers.name: Jakub Šilhavý
speakers.bio: Jakub Šilhavý is a GIS consultant in professional services with ARCDATA PRAHA, the Esri distributor for the Czech Republic, since 2014. He works as an architect and web developer, focusing on developing widgets for ArcGIS Experience Builder, designing ArcGIS Enterprise architecture, and deploying projects involving raster data and utility networks. He holds a doctoral degree in Geographic Information Systems from the University of West Bohemia in Pilsen.

speakers.name: Jennifer Merritt
speakers.bio: Jennifer Merritt is a Senior Product Engineer for the ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps, and she is Product Owner of the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Flutter. She has been with Esri since 2020. Jennifer received a BSc in Geography from the University of Edinburgh and later trained in software development to pursue a career combining these two passions.

speakers.name: Karthik Dutt
speakers.bio: Karthik works as a data scientist at ESRI's R&D Center is New Delhi, working on adding new GeoAI functionalities specifically in Computer vision and NLP to ArcGIS.

speakers.name: Priyanka Tuteja
speakers.bio: Priyanka Tuteja is a Principal Product Engineer at the Esri Research and Development Center in New Delhi, India, where she leads the productization aspects of geospatial AI (GeoAI) tools, pretrained models, and the arcgis.learn API for geospatial deep learning. Priyanka is passionate about creating quality tools for GIS analysts that use the latest AI and data science techniques.

speakers.name: Rami Alouta
speakers.bio: Rami Alouta is a Lead Solutions Engineer at Esri, focused on advancing geospatial AI solutions. Rami leverages cutting-edge technologies to deliver innovative solutions across multiple sectors ranging between the Public, private and None Profit sectors. His expertise includes designing and deploying automation workflows and building well-architected solutions that drive efficiency and value for clients. Recognized as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), Rami is known for his ability to bridge the gap between AI innovation and practical geospatial applications.

speakers.name: Raul Jimenez Ortega
speakers.bio: Raul is a developer on the Developer Experience (DX) team, focused on making the developer journey better through educational resources, tools, community support, and feedback loops. Raul works closely with developers to understand their needs, represent their perspectives internally, and help turn real-world feedback into better products, documentation, and experiences.

speakers.name: Rohit Singh
speakers.bio: Rohit Singh is Director of the Esri Research and Development Center in New Delhi, leading the design and development of geospatial AI (GeoAI) capabilities across ArcGIS. He focuses on advancing GeoAI, foundation models, and scalable spatial analytics to power geospatial applications. Rohit has helped build core ArcGIS technologies, such as the ArcGIS API for Python, the ArcGIS Java Engine API, and the platform’s Linux enablement. He has an MS in Computer Science with a specialization in AI from the Georgia Institute of Technology and is an alumnus of India Institute of Technology, Kharagpur.

speakers.name: Swagata Biswas
speakers.bio: Swagata Biswas has been a Software Developer at Esri since 2020 with a passion for Rust and a background in C++ and Qt. She currently specializes in developing ArcGIS location services and MCP capabilities. She has previously contributed to the development of the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Qt, as well as functional areas of the Native Maps SDKs including geotriggers and offline mapping.

speakers.name: Sascha Brunner
speakers.bio: Sascha Brunner is a Senior Product Engineer at Esri’s Research and Development Center in Zurich, Switzerland. He helps develop 3D capabilities for the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript, working across product design, engineering, documentation, and developer education. Sascha is particularly passionate about the intersection of geographic information systems and artificial intelligence, helping teams adopt modern AI-assisted development workflows. Outside of work, he enjoys ski touring, mountain biking, and creating 3D visualizations inspired by outdoor adventures.

speakers.name: Stefan Eilemann
speakers.bio: Stefan Eilemann works as the technical lead for the 3D Engine team of the ArcGIS Maps SDK for Javascript. Previously he was the technical manager of the Visualization Team in the Blue Brain Project, was the CEO and founder of Eyescale, and the lead developer of the Equalizer parallel rendering framework. He received his PhD in Computer Science at the Visualization and MultiMedia Lab at the University of Zurich in 2019, and his masters degree in Computer Science from EPFL in 2015.

speakers.name: Sam Libby
speakers.bio: Sam Libby is a Principal Architect with Esri, working in the Professional Services division. He works with users, Esri distributors and partners on technology strategy, integrations with external systems or technologies, design of ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online systems, and other topics.

speakers.name: Tobias Hauck
speakers.bio: Tobias Hauck is a Software Development Lead at Esri’s Stuttgart Research and Development Center, where he works on the Reality Engine that powers Esri’s reality mapping products. Since 2016, he has focused on advancing photogrammetry, 3D reconstruction, and reality mapping technologies, helping transform imagery and laser scans into accurate 3D content for GIS and digital twin workflows. Tobias holds a master’s degree in computer animation and visual effects and previously worked in feature film visual effects. He is passionate about reality mapping, digital twins, and software development.

speakers.name: Danny Hatcher
speakers.bio: Danny Hatcher is a Principal Software Development Engineer at Esri, where he works in Esri Labs developing new and emerging technologies. He also serves as the Community Lead for the Professional Services Developer Community, helping developers share knowledge, adopt modern practices, and explore new approaches to software development and AI.

speakers.name: Guenter Doerffel
speakers.bio: Guenter Doerffel is a Technology Evangelist for Imagery and Raster Analytics on Esri’s European BD Team and a member of Esri’s Global Imagery Team. Since 2017, he has supported European distributors in data management, automation, optimization, and raster analytics, including GeoAI. Previously, Guenter spent over 20 years with Esri distributors in Austria and Germany. He holds a degree in forestry and has taught GIS at the university level.

speakers.name: Maartje Holtslag
speakers.bio: Maartje Holtslag is product consultant at Esri Nederland, where she helps users configure and extend ArcGIS to meet real-world needs. With a strong understanding of user workflows and platform capabilities, Maartje enables teams to build intuitive, data-driven solutions that improve field operations and decision-making. Beyond her professional role, Maartje volunteers at a local community farm caring for animals and finds freedom on two wheels, whether cycling on her gravel bike or exploring new horizons on her motorcycle.

speakers.name: Jeroen Van Winden
speakers.bio: CTO Developer Technology, Esri Inc. Euan Cameron is responsible for Developer Technology at Esri and views a well-designed API as valuable as any work of art. Euan has worked in the geospatial software industry for over 35 years developing mapping and analytic products for users and APIs for developers. Euan continues to have fun innovating with mapping APIs and technology. Euan and his wife Julie are outdoor enthusiasts and can often be found in the Sierra Nevada Mountains climbing, skiing, or hiking.

speakers.name: Thomas Paschke
speakers.bio: Thomas is a Senior Product Expert at Esri Germany, working mainly in the Real-Time & Big Data GIS space as well as with GeospatialAI strategies & use cases. He has worked at Esri for over 10 years in different roles, starting as a Product Engineer for the Real-Time Solutions at Esri Inc. transitioning into a Product Expert role at Esri Germany over the last years. He's from Cologne and likes to play different sports like Padel, Kitesurfing or Triathlons, if time permits with 2 young kids.

speakers.name: Mindaugas Rasiukevicius
speakers.bio: Mindaugas Rasiukevicius is an IT solutions architect at HNIT-BALTIC UAB. Mindaugas started their career at Lithuanian Gas utility company as GIS specialist. They helped the company to implement GIS from scratch to fully working Enterprise solution. Being a developer and utility network expert, they currently help other utility companies to implement GIS in their integration with other IT systems and everyday workflows. For the past several years actively specializing in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network solutions. Participated in GIS data migration to Utility Network project for Lithuanian gas and electric operator company ESO AB.

speakers.name: Jan Tschada
speakers.bio: Jan Tschada is a Senior Product Expert for the Developers and Location Services Portfolio at Esri Deutschland GmbH. With over 15 years in GIS, spatial data science, and Location Intelligence, he supports development teams in integrating spatial capabilities using native technologies. As an engineer and business owner, he drives innovation and delivers impactful solutions. His commitment to continuous growth and learning enhances customer success and leads transformative projects.

speakers.name: Janis Müller
speakers.bio: Janis Müller leads the GIS team at ARC-GREENLAB GmbH, specializing in Esri product consulting. He delivers expert guidance on concept development, proof-of-concepts, installations, and configurations. His core expertise includes WebGIS solutions (ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online), mobile applications (ArcGIS Survey123, ArcGIS Field Maps), and specialized tools (ArcGIS Experience Builder, ArcGIS Dashboards, ArcGIS Indoors, ArcGIS GeoBIM). Through customized training and operational support, Janis helps organizations leverage geospatial technology to meet their business goals effectively.

speakers.name: Martin Scherpinski
speakers.bio: Martin is a Software Engineer at con terra with more than a decade of experience working with Esri technology, specializing in ArcGIS Enterprise, its customization and extension, and the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. As a returning speaker at this conference, he has presented on several topics in automation and AI. In his day-to-day work, he is focussing on access control for geospatial data and also helps other development teams as a Scrum Master and workshop facilitator.

speakers.name: Mantas Bukauskas
speakers.bio: Mantas Bukauskas is Chief Systems Architect at Hnit-Baltic (Esri Lithuania), where he has worked since 2013, specializing in Esri technologies with a focus on web solutions and real-time GIS applications. He holds master's degrees in Software Systems Engineering and Nuclear Engineering from Kaunas University of Technology, graduating with honors. Passionate about leveraging GIS technology, Mantas continues to drive innovation and improve spatial data solutions.

speakers.name: Luis Flores Carrubio
speakers.bio: Luis Flores Carrubio is a Product Engineer at Esri working on the ArcGIS Maps SDKs. He has contributed in a variety of areas in both the ArcGIS Maps SDKs for Native Apps and Game Engine SDKs including geometry editing workflows, coordinate systems, game engine user interface, samples, and technical blogs. Luis received his BSc in Computer Science and Physics from the University of Puerto Rico, and his MSc in Computer Games Technology from City, University of London.

speakers.name: Christine Wiltawsky
speakers.bio: Christine Wiltawsky is a Software Engineer in the Professional Services team at Esri Germany since 2012. She specializes in web GIS development, with expertise in JavaScript and ArcGIS Experience Builder. She supports customers in designing and implementing web-based GIS solutions, from standard configurations to advanced custom developments.

speakers.name: Kristian Kaesinger
speakers.bio: Kristian Kaesinger is a Software Engineer at Esri UK. Since joining the organisation in 2021, he has held roles in Technical Support, Professional Services and product development, building expertise in Esri's developer technologies. He now develops products and integrations that help organisations across the UK extend and enhance their use of the ArcGIS platform.

speakers.name: Issy Amis
speakers.bio: Issy Amis is a Technical Support Analyst at Esri UK and has been helping customers solve technical challenges since joining the company in 2021. She specialises in ArcGIS Hub, mobile GIS solutions, and web application development, working closely with organisations to maximise the value of their geospatial technology investments. Alongside her technical expertise, Issy helps lead Esri UK's Initial Response Team, supporting the delivery of high-quality customer service and rapid issue resolution. She enjoys sharing practical knowledge and helping users build engaging, impactful GIS solutions.

speakers.name: Diego Diaz Doce
speakers.bio: Diego Diaz Doce is a Senior Software Engineer at Esri UK, where he develops geospatial solutions using the ArcGIS platform. His expertise spans web application development, spatial data infrastructure, GIS automation, and enterprise geospatial systems. Prior to joining Esri UK in 2019, he spent more than a decade at the British Geological Survey, supporting the delivery of GIS applications and corporate spatial data services. Diego holds an MS in Geographic Information Science and Cartography from The University of Edinburgh.

speakers.name: Alberto Ordonez
speakers.bio: Alberto Ordoñez has been with Esri for 18 years, building his experience across several areas, including Content and Data Management, Technical Support and Professional Services. He is currently the Business Development Manager for Esri Managed Cloud Services at Esri Spain. Launched in 2018, the Managed Cloud Services area now supports more than 40 clients across different sectors, helping them operate and maintain their geospatial platforms through a managed cloud service.

speakers.name: Maciej Żuber
speakers.bio: Maciej Żuber has been a Senior System Architect for Esri Polska since January 2022. He focuses on designing new ArcGIS Enterprise architecture and infrastructure, as well as optimizing and expanding existing ones. Previously, he spent many years designing, implementing, and maintaining GIS solutions for largest Polish software intgrators and telecoms — primarily based on Esri technologies.

speakers.name: Gaëlle Seffers
speakers.bio: Gaëlle Seffers is a GIS Engineer at Esri Belux, where she helps organizations optimize GIS workflows and develop practical geospatial solutions. Her expertise includes ArcGIS, Web GIS, Python automation, spatial analysis, and user training. She holds a Master’s degree in Geographic Information Science and Cartography from Ghent University and has a background in geospatial consulting. She is particularly interested in making geospatial technology accessible and useful to the people who work with it.

speakers.name: Julia Lubiszewska
speakers.bio: Julia Lubiszewska is a Software Developer working on the Native ArcGIS Maps SDKs. She is currently working on the development of the high performance spatial analysis engine. She is passionate about harnessing the power of GPUs and efficiency! He has contributed in a variety of areas including the geometry editor, coordinate systems, game engine user interface, samples, and publishing technical blogs. Luis received his BSc in Computer Science and Physics from the University of Puerto Rico, and his MSc in Computer Games Technology from City, University of London.

speakers.name: Edwin van Meijeren
speakers.bio: Edwin van Meijeren is a Technical Consultant, Developer, and Solution Architect at Esri Nederland. He helps organizations design and implement enterprise Geographic Information System solutions, with a focus on ArcGIS Enterprise, cloud architectures, system integrations, and workflow automation. Edwin works closely with customers to translate business challenges into scalable technical solutions and is passionate about extending GIS platforms through custom development, automation, and emerging technologies.

speakers.name: Adriana Cosse
speakers.bio: Adriana Cossé is a Customer Success Consultant in Esri UK's PreSales team, where she helps organisations realise the value of geospatial technology by aligning solutions with business needs and strategic objectives. Since joining Esri UK in 2022, she has worked with customers in Local Government and Commercial sectors (including Retail, Real Estate and Financial Services), to design and demonstrate solutions that address real-world challenges. Adriana holds an MSc in Global Sustainability Solutions and a BSc in Geography with Applied GIS, both from the University of Exeter.

speakers.name: Christian Grass
speakers.bio: Christian Grass is a Solution Architect in the Solution Engineering team of Esri Switzerland. In his position, he consults the clients in planning, deploying and using ArcGIS in their organization. His focus lies on ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online, including all the different Apps like ArcGIS Field Maps, ArcGIS Experience Builder and so on.

speakers.name: David McRitchie
speakers.bio: David McRitchie has been with Esri UK since 2020, joining via their Graduate Scheme and working within Technical Support after. They are currently a Senior Support Analyst, with a focus on assisting users with Performance, Developer, Enterprise and Database related issues.

speakers.name: Olivia Mitchell
speakers.bio: Olivia Mitchell is a GIS Consultant in Esri UK's Professional Services team. Since joining Esri UK in 2022, she has supported a range of government organisations, providing technical expertise across the ArcGIS system and delivering tailored GIS solutions that help organisations solve real-world problems. Olivia received a degree in Geography with Applied GIS from the University of Exeter.

speakers.name: Álvaro Gutierrez
speakers.bio: Álvaro Gutiérrez is a technology and innovation engineer at Esri Spain, where he is dedicated to creating innovative solutions to solve problems from a geospatial perspective. He is passionate about science and technology and focused on combining the two through Python and JavaScript.

speakers.name: Dave Olsthoorn
speakers.bio: Dave Olsthoorn has been Cloud Engineer at Esri Nederland since 2018. Here he is responsible for setting up and maintaining several different environments which are used to produce, monitor or serve datasets for, among other things, the Living Atlas. All of these environments are setup using automation tools using Infrastructure-as-code. Dave has a Bachelor of Computer Science from the Hague University.

speakers.name: Robert van Gilst
speakers.bio: Robert van Gilst has been with Geoinfo, the Danish esri distributor, as a Senior GIS Developer since 2019. Roberts journey as a GIS Developer started in 2008 and has never looked back since. Robert creates solutions on all levels of ArcGIS Enterprise: frontend, backend and integrations.

speakers.name: Thorben Westerhuys
speakers.bio: Thorben Westerhuys is a Software Engineer on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 3D team at the Esri Research and Development Center in Zürich. He focuses on developer tooling and infrastructure. He received a master’s degree in architecture from the Swiss Federal Institute of Technology Zurich (ETH Zurich) and worked in urban design and planning before moving into map-driven data visualization to support evidence-based planning decisions. Before joining Esri in 2024, he led engineering teams building geospatial data processing and visualization systems.

speakers.name: Robin Renggli
speakers.bio: Robin Renggli is a Software Development Engineer working on the rendering engine of the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript. His work focuses on 3D graphics, WebGL, GPU-based rendering, and performance optimization, including bringing Gaussian splatting to the web. Robin holds a master's degree from ETH Zürich, where he specialized in graphics, computer vision, and machine learning.

speakers.name: Alvar Alonso Rovira
speakers.bio: Àlvar Alonso is a software developer at Esri specializing in game engine technology and real-time graphics. Previously, he spent time teaching college students about game engines and developing video games. In his role, he helps enable game engines to use ArcGIS data and functionality, displaying it efficiently through the engine’s renderer. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Computing Engineering and a Master’s degree in Video Game Development from Pompeu Fabra University.

speakers.name: Omer Kantarcioglu
speakers.bio: ArcGIS Consultant at con terra

speakers.name: Vikram Ponnuswamy
speakers.bio: Vikram Ponnuswamy is a Product Engineer at Esri Cardiff working on ArcGIS Location Platform services. He focuses on developer experience, product usability, service testing, and quality assurance. Working closely with engineering and product teams, he validates new capabilities, builds technical demonstrations, and tests real-world user workflows to identify pain points. He advocates for developers by recommending product improvements that enhance REST API usability and adoption. His current focus is the ArcGIS Static Maps API and Location Platform MCP server.

speakers.name: Andrés Paredes
speakers.bio: Andrés Paredes Fernández is a Cloud & Geospatial Infrastructure Engineer at Esri Spain, where he focuses on the deployment, automation, and maintenance of cloud-based geospatial infrastructures. With a background in systems and MultiCloud administration, he works with technologies such as Azure, AWS, and Terraform to build scalable and efficient environments. Andrés is passionate about cloud infrastructure, automation, and emerging technologies.

speakers.name: Lisa Keurentjes
speakers.bio: Lisa Keurentjes is an Engineer with the Data and Location Services team at Esri Nederland since 2025. Together with her team, she helps maintain and enhance the Living Atlas. She specializes in automating data workflows through ArcGIS Notebooks and Python toolboxes, enabling more efficient data management, improved data quality, and more frequent updates. Alongside automation, she enjoys creating effective cartography, compelling data visualizations, and engaging Arcade-based user experiences for pop-ups and dashboards.

speakers.name: Stefan Schläfli
speakers.bio: Stefan is a software engineer working for Esri Switzerland in Zürich. He is customizing Esri products and developing software for Swiss customers.

speakers.name: Antonín Procházka
speakers.bio: Antonín is a senior software engineer at CETIN, where he builds and operates enterprise systems that support the Czech nationwide telecommunications infrastructure. His work focuses on .NET development, software architecture, system integration, DevOps, CI/CD, and automation, with ArcGIS Enterprise as one of the key platforms he works with. He develops custom ArcGIS Server extensions and the tooling and infrastructure around their development, deployment, and operation.

speakers.name: Mika Dinnus
speakers.bio: Mika Dinnus has been a Sales Engineer with Esri Germany since 2025, working in the Sales Engineering Team. With an academic background in Spatial Data Science and Computer Vision, he has developed a deep understanding of complex data structures and how modern Artificial Intelligence systems work. At Esri, he supports organizations in adopting Generative Artificial Intelligence and agentic systems in ways that are both technically sound and strategically meaningful, from architectural decisions to platform considerations.

speakers.name: Filip Ciotkowski
speakers.bio: Filip Ciółkowski is a GIS Specialist at Esri Polska, where he has worked since March 2024. He supports organizations in implementing ArcGIS solutions, delivers GIS consulting services, and provides professional training in enterprise geodatabases. His experience combines forestry, geospatial technologies, databases, and software development, including work in Ireland's forestry sector and on software solutions for forestry and environmental organizations. Filip holds degrees from Warsaw University of Life Sciences and Eberswalde University for Sustainable Development.

speakers.name: Jørgen Storlie
speakers.bio: Jørgen is the Manager mobile solutions Norwegian Air Ambulance with over 30 years of experience in database and software development across desktop and mobile platforms. He has specialized in design and implementation of mission-critical solutions, driving technological advancements in aviation, healthcare and emergency service.

speakers.name: Claire Drean
speakers.bio: Claire Drean is a Product Engineer on the Location Platform Services team, where she contributes to MCP development and ArcGIS Location Services. She joined Esri in 2026 and brings 10 years of GIS experience, primarily in consulting roles, helping organizations implement geospatial solutions across a range of sectors, including defence, mining, forestry and local government.

speakers.name: Marcin Sutuła
speakers.bio: Marcin Sutuła has been a Data Engineer with Allegro since 2025, where he focuses on GIS data engineering, ArcGIS Enterprise administration and infrastructure, and building spatial data pipelines. He also develops GIS applications and automation that support Allegro Delivery network. Previously, Marcin worked as a GIS Engineer at PwC and as a Developer at Esri Poland, where he built solutions across the ArcGIS platform.

speakers.name: Emil Erlenkötter
speakers.bio: Emil Erlenkötter has been working as a student employee at con terra GmbH in the ArcGIS Sales and Customer Success department since 2025. His main focus is on working with 3D data and testing new AI features in the Esri ecosystem. At the same time, he is pursuing a master’s degree in Geoinformatics and Spatial Data Science at the University of Münster.

speakers.name: Ben Giese
speakers.bio: Ben Giese has been a Software Engineer GIS with EnBW Energie Baden-Württemberg AG since 2025. His focus is agentic coding with the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript and AI assistants that change how users interact with GIS applications. Previously, he worked as a student employee at Esri Deutschland and interned at Deutsche Bahn, where he contributed to live tracking solutions. Ben holds a BSc in Geography and an MSc in Geoinformatics and Spatial Data Science from the University of Münster. Outside of work, he enjoys traveling, fitness, and running.

speakers.name: Israel Ketema
speakers.bio: Israel Ketema is a GIS Business Consultant in the renewable energy sector at Esri Belux. He helps organizations implement geospatial workflows, data integrations, and location intelligence solutions using ArcGIS technologies to improve business decision making and operational efficiency.
